Our next initiative

Project 1,000 Smiles

More than a number. A commitment.

A year-round community impact initiative in the making, built to carry the hope and belonging we bring every December into every month of the year, for children, mothers and communities.

Keep Me PostedHow it began
ComingSoon

Where it started

One Saturday was never going to be enough.

Christmas in the Street began with 50 children planned and 150 who came. By Edition 3 it was 754. Every year more children showed up and every year we felt how much a single day in December can’t hold.

We don’t believe people should only be remembered when there is an event, a crisis or a festive season. Project 1,000 Smiles is how we plan to keep showing up.

Read the Christmas in the Street story

Where we started from:

Where a child comes from should never determine the kind of childhood they get to experience.

The goal

1,000 moments, not 1,000 gifts.

The goal isn’t simply to create 1,000 smiles. It is to create 1,000 moments of hope, inclusion and possibility while building something that can continue long after the smile fades.

0 of 1,000 so far

The wall starts empty — every space is waiting for a real moment.

How we’ll build it

Four promises we’re holding ourselves to.

  • Listen before we act

    We start by understanding what a community actually needs, not what we assume it does.

  • Show up consistently

    Sustainable change needs consistency. Instead of one-off moments of generosity, we are building a steady, year-round connection.

  • Create opportunities, not dependency

    The aim is pathways and possibilities, people as active participants in a better future, not only recipients of support.

  • Measure and share our impact

    We track what happens and tell you about it plainly, so you can see what your support is doing.

Questions

What people ask us.

Is Project 1,000 Smiles running yet?

Not yet. We’re preparing to launch, and we’d rather tell you that plainly than promise something that isn’t ready. When it is, you’ll hear it from us first.

Does Christmas in the Street continue?

Yes. Edition 4 is on Saturday, December 19, 2026. Project 1,000 Smiles is built to sit alongside it, carrying the same spirit through the rest of the year.

Is 1,000 the finish line?

No. 1,000 is the commitment to 1,000 moments of hope, inclusion and possibility. The aim is to build something that can continue long after the smile fades.

How can I help before it launches?

Tell us you’re interested, volunteer for Edition 4, partner with us, or give. Every one of those helps build what comes next.

Be there from day one.

Tell us you’re interested and we’ll keep you posted or help build what comes next in the meantime.
